Name: DECISION: Confirm pediatric clinical reviewer for Health content
Notes: BLOCKING FOR LAUNCH. We are shipping triage advice to frightened parents; it needs a doctor's sign-off before release. No reviewer is named today. Longest lead time on the project - start day 1, not week 5.

Name: DECISION: Legal review - COPPA / HIPAA / state health-privacy exposure
Notes: We are storing infant health data under real accounts and nobody has checked whether we are allowed to. Also covers whether the Fever Checker risks being classified as a medical device.

Name: Create GitHub org + repo, push scaffold, set branch protection
Notes: Org bumptobloom. Protect main and develop. Require 1 review + green CI. Add CODEOWNERS handles.

Name: Create Supabase project, apply migration 0001, verify RLS
Notes: US region. Then prove isolation with two real accounts - Mom A must not see Mom B's baby.

Name: Freeze API contracts with all pod leads
Notes: docs/API-CONTRACTS.md. After this, changing a shape needs a PR. This is what lets 5 timezones work without blocking.

Name: Tell design: onboarding becomes a date picker, not a month slider
Notes: ADR-004. Answers the designers' open question 'complex level of collecting days/weeks/months data'. Store birth_date, derive age. Also fixes 'kids between months'.

Name: Tell design: pregnancy is out of MVP, need a 'coming soon' screen
Notes: ADR-002. Roughly a third of current Figma screens (every 'Week 24' one) have no v1 implementation. Design needs to hear this explicitly.

Name: Tell design: Track is missing the Social/Emotional domain
Notes: Figma shows 3 domains. Counter says '0 of 9' but only 6 checkboxes render - the missing 3 are the absent section. Master sheet lists social-emotional in one row and says 'at least three' in another, so this is a should-have not a blocker.

Name: Tell design: Track has no disclaimer; copy is already approved
Notes: Exact copy already sits in the Master sheet, approved. Legally the most important screen to have a disclaimer on, and the Figma does not show one.

Name: Tell design: fever article must run severity high-to-low
Notes: Currently leads with a green 'Usually manageable at home' block. An emergency-tier result must never land a parent on home-care advice first.

Name: Ratify naming + nav order
Notes: Commerce tab has 5 names across our docs: Cart, Act, Sprout Cart, Bloom Cart, Essentials. Proposal: Cart in the UI, act in code and routes. Nav order Home-Track-Learn-Ask-Health-Cart.

Name: Scaffold Expo app: TypeScript, Expo Router, NativeWind
Notes: BLOCKS most of week 1. Everyone should be able to run `npx expo start` and open the app in Expo Go on their own phone by Wednesday.

Name: Supabase Auth: log in, create account, forgot password
Notes: Matches existing Figma screens 1-2. Master sheet marks login and create-account as Must have.

Name: Extract design tokens from Figma into the NativeWind theme
Notes: Design-change log item 1 was 'fonts are not consistent throughout'. Tokens are how that stops recurring.

Name: Build the Expo Router tab navigator for all six tabs
Notes: Order: Home-Track-Learn-Ask-Health-Cart. Flag: 6 tabs exceeds the 5-item convention on iOS and Android.

Name: Baby profile: create + edit, date picker, derived age
Notes: birth_date is the source of truth. Nothing stores 'month 8'. Optional due_date for preterm.

Name: Scaffold the Ask Edge Function and deploy a stub
Notes: Supabase Edge Function, Deno + TypeScript. Returns a hardcoded string this week. It exists because the OpenAI key can NEVER ship inside the app bundle - anything in a mobile build can be extracted in five minutes.

Name: Set up EAS Build and get a dev build onto real devices
Notes: Expo Go covers most work, but anything with native modules needs a dev build. Get one onto an iPhone and an Android before week 2.

Name: Register Apple Developer and Google Play accounts
Notes: LONG LEAD, START DAY 1. Apple is $99/yr, Google is $25 one-time. Apple identity verification can take days. Google requires new PERSONAL accounts to run a closed test with 12 testers for 14 continuous days before production - register as an ORGANISATION to avoid that, or we cannot be on Play by Oct 6.

Name: Half-day React Native ramp-up for anyone new to it
Notes: Nobody listed React Native on the intake sheet. The gap from React is small - View instead of div, Text instead of p, no CSS cascade - but it is not zero. Do it once, together, rather than eleven people googling separately.

Name: Begin CDC milestone dataset extraction
Notes: cdc.gov/act-early/milestones. All 4 domains x 9 checkpoints (0,2,4,6,9,12,15,18,24).

Name: Everyone: read DECISIONS + ONBOARDING + SAFETY, get dev env running
Notes: Six decisions were made before onboarding. Reading them prevents most rework.

Name: Seed milestones: 4 domains x 9 checkpoints, with sources
Notes: Every row needs a source_label. Every card shows where its advice came from - that is what separates this from a forum post.

Name: Milestones data layer: fetch, mark noticed, unmark
Notes: Direct Supabase calls. RLS is the access control - there is no API server to hide behind.

Name: Track screen: checkpoint navigator, 4 domains, progress counter
Notes: Replace the unlabeled 1-6 pagination in the Figma with real checkpoint months.

Name: Render the Track disclaimer on every checklist view
Notes: Non-dismissible. Copy is in the Master sheet and in docs/SAFETY.md.

Name: Home data layer: getHome() with Supabase queries
Notes: apps/mobile/lib/api/. Screens never see raw table rows.

Name: Home screen: profile card, this-week card, quick actions
Notes: Per design-change log: Bloom bar removed, nav at bottom, edit icon on profile card.

Name: Activities: table, seed, data layer
Design Ask prompt architecture and baby-context builder
Notes: Age in months only. No name, no user id, nothing identifying reaches OpenAI. Runs in the Edge Function, not on the device.

Name: Age derivation utility + tests, including preterm corrected age
Notes: Server-side only. Clients never compute age and never cache it across days.

Name: RLS isolation test suite: two accounts, every private table
Notes: Automated, runs in CI. On mobile this matters more than it would on the web: the app talks to Supabase directly, so RLS IS our entire access-control layer. There is no server to catch a mistake.

Name: Build Learn content dataset: Developmental, Feeding, Sleep, Diaper
Learn data layer: fetch by age and category, save, unsave
Learn screen with category filters and save
Finalise fever rules engine, set RULES_VERSION
Notes: Engine + 33-case test table are already written. This is the review and version pin.

Name: Send fever rules and result copy to clinical reviewer
Notes: Deliberately in week 3, not week 5, so review runs in parallel across weeks 4-6 instead of blocking launch. Depends on the week 1 reviewer task.

Name: Wire the fever engine into the app and log results
Notes: assessFever() runs ON THE DEVICE so it works offline - a mom at 2am on bad wifi still gets an answer. Age comes from birth_date fetched at login; the app never asks for one. Logging to Supabase is fire-and-forget: if it fails, the parent already has their answer and must never see an error.

Name: fever_checks logging with rule_id and rules_version
Notes: Without rule_id + version we cannot reconstruct what the app told a parent, or why.

Name: Build Ask evaluation harness
Notes: Golden question set with expected behaviours, including symptom questions that must redirect.

Name: E2E test: onboarding -> home -> track, on a real device
Notes: Maestro or Detox. Runs against a dev build, not Expo Go.

Name: Build product catalog with a written rationale per product
Notes: Every card must say why the product is recommended. A recommendation without a reason is just an advert.

Name: Recommendation rules by age bucket (0-3, 4-8, 9-14, 15-24)
Recommendations data layer + retailer search URLs
Notes: Plain search links, no affiliate programme: https://www.amazon.com/s?k=belly+oil - build the URL template per retailer.

Name: Cart screen with retailer links, no checkout, no list total
Notes: Design-change log: remove 'Add to List' and all payment steps. Also fixes the truncated '2 it' bug on the list screen.

Name: Ask: OpenAI integration and context builder
Ask: Zod response validation + ai_runs logging
Ask: triage guard tests and keyword tuning
Notes: Symptom questions must redirect to Health BEFORE any model call. Bias to false positives.

Name: Ask: conversation persistence and history queries
Notes: History reads straight from Supabase with RLS - no Edge Function needed for that half.

Name: Ask chat screen with standing disclaimer
Notes: Keyboard handling on a phone is the fiddly part - test with the keyboard open on a small screen.

Name: Wire PostHog events per tech-stack doc section 15
Notes: Health events excluded from any ad-targeting integration.

Name: Fever Checker screen: auto age, method selector, red-flag list
Notes: Method selector is new vs the Figma and it matters - an axillary reading runs ~1F low, so 99.5 armpit in a 2-month-old is an emergency.

Name: Three fever result screens, severity high-to-low
Notes: HOME / CALL / EMERGENCY. The emergency screen is the one worth demoing - it shows the safety story.

Name: Persistent 911 banner above the fold on every Health screen
Apply clinical reviewer feedback to rules and copy
Notes: Bump RULES_VERSION. Update the test table in the same PR.

Name: Ask conversation history and sidebar
Notes: Master sheet asked for this: 'save the history on the left navigation as ChatGPT'.

Name: Wire Sentry React Native, with source maps for both platforms
Notes: Without source maps a crash report is unreadable hex. Set them up now, not after the first crash.

Name: Device pass: small iPhone, large Android, and one old slow phone
Notes: Our users are often on whatever phone they already had. Test on something cheap and three years old, not just a flagship.

Name: Accessibility pass: VoiceOver, TalkBack, large text
Notes: Our users are sleep-deprived and often in low light at 3am. Contrast and text scaling matter more here than on a normal product.

Name: Run Ask evals, tune prompt, pin the winning version
RLS penetration test against a seeded multi-account dataset
Full E2E suite green across all six tabs on a real device
Safety test table final pass and sign-off
Record clinical sign-off in REVIEW.md
Notes: HARD LAUNCH GATE. Without this the Health tab cannot ship to real parents. Everything else can be perfect and we still do not launch.

Name: Performance: cold start under 3s on a mid-tier phone
Notes: Cold start is the number that matters on mobile, not first paint.

Name: Beta with 10-20 real first-time parents
Bug triage and fixes from beta
Ship to TestFlight and Play internal testing, smoke test
Notes: Internal distribution, not the public stores - no review queue, and it demos identically. Public listing is a stretch goal, not the Oct 6 plan.

Name: App store assets: icon, splash, screenshots, privacy labels
Notes: Both stores require a privacy declaration. We collect infant health data, so this must match whatever Vishnu's privacy policy says - they are read together.

Name: Ask module structure and OpenAI client setup
Notes: Own apps/web/src/lib/ask end to end - Pod W is not in the loop for Ask changes.

Name: Ask: prompt versioning and rollout mechanism
Notes: prompt_versions table with one active row. Every ai_runs row records which version answered.

Name: Ask: conversation context window management and truncation
Notes: History caps at 20 messages per the contract. Decide what gets dropped and prove it stays coherent.

Name: Ask: rate limiting, timeout handling and graceful failure
Notes: 15s timeout. On any error the client shows a plain failure state - it never falls back to a cached or generated answer.

Name: Ask: build the eval question set with Keya
Notes: Golden set must include symptom questions that are required to redirect, and edge cases near the guard's keyword boundaries.

Name: Ask cost projection at beta scale
Notes: We need a per-user cost number before anyone talks about scaling this.

Name: Confirm retailer links are plain search URLs, not affiliate
Notes: Confirmed: we use plain search links like https://www.amazon.com/s?k=belly+oil - no programme application, no approval wait. Trade-off worth saying out loud: no revenue and no click tracking in v1. Cart is a convenience feature, not a revenue feature.

Name: Recruit the beta cohort - 10 to 20 first-time parents
Notes: Starts week 2, not week 6. Finding, screening and scheduling real first-time moms takes weeks. The week 6 beta task depends entirely on this being done early.

Name: Approve Learn content copy before it ships
Notes: Natasha builds the dataset; someone has to sign off that the copy is accurate and on-brand before it reaches parents. Check every card carries a source label too.

Name: Publish privacy policy and Terms of Service
Notes: Hard gate on the beta. We cannot put real parents' infant health data into a product with no privacy policy, and we need a stated retention and deletion policy. Pairs with Katrina's legal review.
